title: Jab Mehnat Ke Baad Bhi Phal Na Mile | Bhagavad Gita Chapter 2 Verse 47 | Shri Krishna Updesh
hook: Jab aap din-raat mehnat karein, aur badle me sirf asafalta aur dukh mile... tab man me ek hi sawal aata hai: Kya meri koshish bekar thi? Is dukh se nikalne ke liye Shri Krishna ne Arjuna ko kya gyan diya tha? Dhyan se suniye.
sanskrit:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥
vyakhya: Bhagwan Shri Krishna kehte hain: Hey Arjuna! Tera adhikar kewal karm karne par hai, uske phalon par kabhi nahi. Isliye karm ke phal ka hetu mat ban, aur karm na karne me bhi teri aashakti na ho. Jab tum result ki chinta chhod kar kewal apne kartavya par dhyan kendrit karte ho, tabhi man ko sachhi shanti aur asim shakti milti hai.

title: Sukh aur Dukh me Shant Rahna Seekhein | Bhagavad Gita Adhyay 2 Shloka 14 | Gita Saar
hook: Jeevan me jab mushkilein aati hain, toh insaan toot jata hai. Lekin Shri Krishna kehte hain ki dukh hamesha ke liye nahi hota. Suniye is shloka ka anmol rahasya.
vyakhya: Shri Krishna kehte hain: Hey Kunti putra! Sardi-garmi aur sukh-dukh ka anubhav indriyon aur vishayon ke milan se hota hai. Yeh sab aane-jaane wale aur anitya hain. Inhe sahansheelta ke sath sahana seekho. Jo dukh me ghabrata nahi aur sukh me ahankari nahi hota, wahi param shanti ko prapt karta hai.
